scene_description: Library shelf of reference books ending at a metal bookend. Blue and green volumes stand upright on the left. The beige index leans on a tilted green Bompiani volume, and three Bompiani volumes lie stacked by the bookend. Book sizes are for books lying flat; front is the open face of the shelf.

targets.name: blue A-K dictionary
targets.description: Blue 'dictionnaire des Littératures' A-K volume standing at the far left end of the shelf.
nearby_obstacles: Left end of the shelf
Blue L-Z volume touching its right side
Shelf about 1-3 cm above its top
targets.clearance_notes: Packed against the shelf end and the L-Z volume, with almost no room above it.

candidate_improvements.description: Pull the book approximately 5 cm forward so its sides stick out past its neighbors.

targets.name: blue L-Z dictionary
targets.description: Blue 'dictionnaire des Littératures' L-Z volume standing between the blue A-K volume and the green A-F volume.
nearby_obstacles: Blue A-K volume touching its left side
Green A-F volume touching its right side
Shelf about 1-3 cm above its top
targets.clearance_notes: Packed between books on both sides, with almost no room above it.

candidate_improvements.description: Pull the book approximately 5 cm forward so its sides stick out past its neighbors.

targets.name: green G-O dictionary
targets.description: Green 'Dictionnaire universel des littératures' G-O volume standing between the green A-F and P-Z volumes.
nearby_obstacles: Green A-F volume touching its left side
Green P-Z volume touching its right side
Shelf about 1-3 cm above its top
targets.clearance_notes: Packed between books on both sides, with almost no room above it.

candidate_improvements.description: Pull the book approximately 5 cm forward so its sides stick out past its neighbors.

targets.other_notes: The green A-F volume is identical and sits the same way.

targets.name: green P-Z dictionary
targets.description: Green 'Dictionnaire universel des littératures' P-Z volume, the rightmost upright green volume, with the leaning beige index at its lower right.
nearby_obstacles: Green G-O volume touching its left side
Bottom of the leaning beige index on its right
Shelf about 1-3 cm above its top
targets.clearance_notes: Left side is packed; the upper right side is open where the index leans away.

candidate_improvements.description: Pull the book approximately 5 cm forward so its sides stick out past its neighbors.

targets.name: beige index
targets.description: Thin beige 'Index des oeuvres' volume leaning diagonally to the right, resting on the tilted green Bompiani volume.
targets.orientation: leaning to the right at about 45 degrees
nearby_obstacles: Tilted green Bompiani volume under it
Top black Bompiani volume at its upper end
targets.clearance_notes: Mostly exposed, but propped on another book and may slide when touched.

candidate_improvements.description: Stand the index upright beside the green P-Z volume, spine facing out.

targets.name: tilted green Bompiani volume
targets.description: Small green 'Dizionario Bompiani' volume tilted to the right underneath the leaning beige index.
targets.orientation: tilted to the right, spine facing out
nearby_obstacles: Beige index resting on it
Stacked Bompiani volumes to its right
targets.clearance_notes: The beige index lies across it, leaving only the spine and lower edge exposed.

candidate_improvements.description: Stand the beige index upright first, then stand this volume upright.

targets.name: bottom black Bompiani volume
targets.description: Small black 'Dizionario Bompiani' volume lying flat at the bottom of the three-book stack.
nearby_obstacles: Green and black Bompiani volumes stacked on top of it
targets.clearance_notes: Only the spine and edges are exposed; two books rest on top.

candidate_improvements.description: Lift the two volumes above it off the stack and stand them upright on the shelf.

targets.name: middle green Bompiani volume
targets.description: Small green 'Dizionario Bompiani' volume lying flat in the middle of the three-book stack, between the two black volumes.
nearby_obstacles: Top black Bompiani volume resting on it
Bottom black Bompiani volume underneath
targets.clearance_notes: Spine and edges are exposed, but the top black volume covers it.

candidate_improvements.description: Lift the top black volume off the stack and stand it upright on the shelf.

targets.name: top black Bompiani volume
targets.description: Small black 'Dizionario Bompiani' volume lying flat on top of the three-book stack, next to the bookend.
nearby_obstacles: Upper end of the beige index touching its left side
Bookend to its right
targets.clearance_notes: Top and spine are exposed, with several centimeters of space above it.

targets.name: bookend
targets.description: Black metal bookend at the right end of the shelf, beside the stack of Bompiani volumes.
nearby_obstacles: Top black Bompiani volume beside it
targets.clearance_notes: Top edge and right side are open.

source: Staged permutation of S0029 and S0033, using the same objects in a different arrangement.
